_comment: Conservative GTFS encodings of prescriptions that would otherwise generate illegal itineraries. direction_id 0 = as-printed (andata), 1 = reverse.

rules.why: divieto di esercizio locale Montevago<->S.Margherita: on andata the only upstream boarding point is Montevago, so alighting here is exactly the forbidden local trip. EXACTNESS DEPENDS on Montevago being the sole upstream stop — the assertion fails the build if a fresher sheet adds one.
on ritorno, the only stop after S.Margherita is the Montevago terminus, so boarding here can only produce the forbidden local trip. Same exactness condition, asserted downstream.
